interactions.note: The epitope of 2F2 Fab on the JEV (P3 strain) envelope protein was determined from cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) micrographs of JEV–2F2-Fab. The cryo-EM structure was determined to a resolution of 4.7 Å by single-particle techniques.

The epitope of 2H4 Fab on the JEV (P3 strain) envelope protein was determined from cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) micrographs of JEV–2H4-Fab, determined to a resolution of 4.6 Å by single-particle techniques.

The epitope of RRV-12 Fab on E2 of RRV was determined from the single-particle cryo-EM reconstruction of the complex of Fab bound to the purified RRV virus at a resolution of 6.33 Å. The alpha carbon backbone of the alphavirus E1, E2 structural glycoproteins and the Fab model CHK-265 were used to identify and interpret the maps.

The epitope of RRV-12 Fab on E2 of MAYV was determined from the single-particle cryo-EM reconstruction of the complex of Fab bound to the purified MAYV virus at a resolution of 5.3 Å. The alpha carbon backbone of the alphavirus E1, E2 structural glycoproteins and the Fab model CHK-265 were used to identify and interpret the maps.

The epitope of the epitope specific mAb on the SINV/EEEV chimeric VLP was determined by single particle reconstruction cryo-electron microscopy at a resolution of 4.6 Å.  Localized reconstruction combined with focused classification and refinement of the two q3 spikes bound to EEEV-373 were performed, providing a global resolution estimate of ~3.8 Å.
The Fab was incubated with VEEV TC-83 virus particles and cryo-EM reconstructions were used to identified E2 contact residues comprising the epitope.

The epitope for the epitope specific mAb on the VEEV TC-83 VLP was determined by single particle reconstruction cryo-electron microscopy of the complex at a resolution of 4 Å with local refinement to 3.2 Å.

interactions.assay: in vivo assay · pathogen burden after challenge after adoptive transfer
interactions.note: Four-week old male WT C57BL/6 mice were treated with epitope-specific mAb 24 hpi with 10^3 FFU of RRV. The gastrocnemius (calf muscle), ankle, spleen, and quadriceps were harvested 3 dpi and viral RNA burden was measured by qRT-PCR.
